# MONARO8

> MONARO8 is an independent digital advisory based in the Snowy Monaro, Australia. Grounded in enterprise-scale strategy and hands-on product building, it helps organisations make better digital decisions and turn them into working outcomes—from initial strategy through to delivery. It is a registered business name of Open County Pty Ltd (ACN 679 154 557, ABN 19 679 154 557).

MONARO8 is led by Oliver Moran, a product leader and AI builder with 15 years of experience delivering enterprise-scale digital platforms. He is the founder of ZerraLedger and has built practical software products including Zerra, BatteryMe, and AllFlights, alongside accelerator experience with Antler Singapore and EnergyLab.

MONARO8 works across regional NSW, Canberra, Sydney and Australia-wide, and is independent of vendors with no commissions on recommendations.

## Services

- [Home](https://monaro8.com.au/): overview, positioning and ways to start
- [Services](https://monaro8.com.au/services/): Strategy (digital strategy and roadmaps, platform/vendor decisions, AI strategy, board papers), Product leadership (interim or fractional product leadership, product audits, customer journeys), Delivery (MVPs and prototypes, product features, customer journeys and workflows built end-to-end)
- [About](https://monaro8.com.au/about/): background on Oliver Moran and how MONARO8 works
- [Contact](https://monaro8.com.au/contact/): hello@monaro8.com.au

## Ways to start

- Discovery Conversation — 45 minutes, free: understand your situation, explore options, identify what to focus on first
- Digital Audit — 2 to 3 weeks, price on request: current-state review with top 10 issues and fixes
- Strategy and Roadmap — 4 to 6 weeks, price on request: board-ready roadmap and first 90 days planned
- Ongoing Advisory — monthly, price on request: fractional product or digital leadership
